messages.subject: clustering error
parts:
Hi folks,

I’m having troubles with an error in openCR 1.4.1. I would really appreciate if anyone could give me some tips on fixing this error. I’ve already tried reinstalling R and updating all packages. Normally this code works great. But now I’m having a “cluster” issue. No errors in read.capthist. No errors in plotting my shapefile or traps and tracks. I’m at a complete loss.

Thanks,

Cheryl

 

> IA<-read.capthist(captfile="2012_2019_IA_SECR_capturedata.txt",

+                   trapfile = list("2012MAY_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2012OCT_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2013APR_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2013OCT_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2014MAY_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2014OCT_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2015_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2016_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2017_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2018_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2019MAY_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt",

+                                   "2019AUG_IA_SECR_traplocs_BLinterferenceremoved.txt"),

+                   detector = "multi",

+                   fmt=c("trapID","XY"),

+                   covnames=list("Species","Sex"))

No errors found :-)

Warning message:

In make.capthist(captures = capturelist[[i]], traps = trps, fmt = fmt,  :

  dropping repeat detections within occasions at exclusive detectors (traps)

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: clustering error
parts:
A similar error was reported on phidot http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=36&t=3982#p13176
The OP hasn't come back on that, so I don't know if it was resolved. The problem is in join() that is called by openCR.fit() if the user has not pre-processed the data into the required form. Troubleshoot by calling join() yourself. I don't know at this stage whether there is a bug.
Murray

Thanks,

Cheryl

 

From: secr...@googlegroups.com <secr...@googlegroups.com> On Behalf Of Murray Efford

Sent: Wednesday, 25 March 2020 6:26 AM
To: secr <secr...@googlegroups.com>

Subject: Re: clustering error

 

[External Email] This email was sent from outside the department – be cautious, particularly with links and attachments.

A similar error was reported on phidot http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=36&t=3982#p13176

The OP hasn't come back on that, so I don't know if it was resolved. The problem is in join() that is called by openCR.fit() if the user has not pre-processed the data into the required form. Troubleshoot by calling join() yourself. I don't know at this stage whether there is a bug.

Murray
